summary: Element-wise adds two 3D vectors and returns the squared length of the sum. Reads X/Y/Z from this+0x7C (this[31]), this+0x80 (this[32]) and this+0x84 (this[33]) and adds a2[0], a2[1], a2[2] respectively, then returns v3*v3 + v2*v2 + v4*v4 (sum of squares, no square root). Pure computation with no branches, guards, globals or callees; called by MinimumDistanceSearch (0x0040ACD0) and ShortComputation (0x0040B630).

operations.description: Compute v4 = this[31] (this+0x7C) + a2[0], the X component of the summed vector.
Compute v2 = this[32] (this+0x80) + a2[1], the Y component of the summed vector.
Compute v3 = this[33] (this+0x84) + a2[2], the Z component of the summed vector.
Return the squared length of the summed vector: v3*v3 + v2*v2 + v4*v4.
Invoked from MinimumDistanceSearch (0x0040ACD0) and ShortComputation (0x0040B630), consistent with distance-squared use.
